entities.name: PMID:27507944
observations: Baillet et al. (2016), pilot study in 45 older adults; actigraphy over at least three consecutive nights and ecological momentary assessment evaluated sleep-duration discrepancy and mood.

entities.name: Mood and sleep discrepancy
observations: In a pilot sample of 45 older adults, mood status at awakening statistically explained the discrepancy between EMA-reported and actigraphic sleep duration (p=0.020); overall discrepancy was significant (p<0.001).
The discrepancy was not associated with age, sex, sleep quality, or memory performance; observational pilot evidence does not establish causality.
